content.title: Analyze portfolio allocation
content.description: An investment professional reviews how the portfolio is distributed across asset classes, uses the donut chart and legend to compare percentages and values, and focuses on a selected allocation by hovering or locking a segment until the chart or time-range context changes.
content.value: Shows portfolio composition and helps the user focus on individual allocation slices.
criteria: Allocation slices are Equities 48%, Fixed Income 24%, Alternatives 13%, Cash 9%, and Commodities 6%.
The chart center shows $24.8M TOTAL and the legend shows asset class, percentage, and value.
Hovering a segment expands it by 4px, highlights the matching legend item, and replaces the center label with the selected allocation.
Clicking locks a segment, clicking the same segment again unlocks it, and changing chart or time-range context clears selection.
